Bosch BME280 SensorAPI, vendored unmodified (BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/boschsensortec/BME280_SensorAPI

    bme280.c  bme280.h  bme280_defs.h  LICENSE

Compiled with BME280_32BIT_ENABLE (see ../../CMakeLists.txt): integer compensation, no FPU
needed. Units of `struct bme280_data` in that mode: temperature in 0.01 degC, pressure in Pa,
humidity in 1/1024 %RH.
